newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to hold news conference next Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to hold news conference next Tuesday.

text.p: President Clinton will hold a full-scale news conference on Tuesday, Jan. 28, the White House announced on Tuesday.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton's session with reporters would take place in the afternoon, and that it would not focus on any particular topic.
"Right now, there are no pending announcements or big pieces of news," McCurry said.
Clinton last held a news conference in mid-December when he announced a series of nominations to his Cabinet.
